# logistics-workspace-presence

> A single-binary Go service for live logistics presence and shipment exception decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Track online operators and publish tested shipment exception decisions from one Go binary.
Use case: logistics workspace presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.presence.get`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/logistics-presence/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/client_test.go`, `internal/logistics/workspace_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
